Sharing my opinions regarding courses and faculties choosing
ENG102 (SLQ) - Maam is kinda strict and biased but as a teacher she is very good and her teaching quality is really impressive but to get good grade ,you have to be liked by her.
MAT116 (MHSN) - One of the sweetest faculties i have ever met. Her teaching quality is not top notch but she tries her best to teach. Main thing she curves a lot. Just follow her lecture slides and practice questions and you are good to go.
CEE100 (HASW) - Sir is super friendly and chill. He tries to make your basic strong and he teaches really good. You get fair grade and you will enjoy his class.
Ben205 (RME) - Keep oiling and you will get good grade. If you are just an average student like me ,its better to avoid her.
ENG103 (NPN) - She literally gives motherly vibes. Teaches very good and make you understand all the topic perfectly. She doesn’t curve at all but you can learn the course from the basic and fluently.
CEE110 (SJD) - After some classes you may think that maam is strict but actually she is reallt sweet and whatever she does does for your good. You will understand this after the last class. Just go through her classes learn perfectly what she teaches and you are good to go for an A or A-
MAT120 (ALQ) - Friendly teacher. Gives you bro vibes. Super easygoing. Teaches really good just follow his lecture and you are ready.
ENV107 (ARK) - The full semester you will go through a huge mental pressure for his questions and suggestions quantity but after the grade submission you will thank him from the core of your heart. Sir is nice and tries his best to teach. Make jokes which can make you bored but he is such a gentleman.
SOC101 (MJUN) - Friendly and Supportive. Couldn’t complete his course so dont know about his grading but he is actually nice.
SOC101 (MTE) - Just avoid him.
CEE210 (NMSN) - Sir is actually nice and friendly. He understands student's emotions. He will help you a lot if you go to his office. He curves a lot. I mean a lot.
CEE213 (SLW) - Another goated faculty. By doing his course you not only learn the course but also get the proper knowledge needed for day to day life. His teaching quality is top notch and he is very professional thats why i like him very much.
CHE101 (MASM) - Actual "মাটির মানুষ" He cant teach that good but he tries. He is a very good and friendly human being. He doesn’t curve but you will get very good grade from him as his questions are prettt easy and comes from his class.
MAT130 (SBW) - Sir is nice and bold. He curves 10rootx. Just do the maths he marks and its easy to get good grades under him.
CHE101L (AVC) - Sir is friendly and gives you multiple opportunities to submit lab reports. He gives raw marks.
Hope these help you. I just gave my opinion.
